intentEvidence: Companion to PhraseSync — PhraseSync handles mid-sentence linking, while At Link provides an explicit @ trigger for when you deliberately want to insert a wikilink.
problem: Manually constructing complex wikilinks for notes, headings, or blocks is time-consuming and prone to errors.
